About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: Dubai, UAE 
 About the role 
 The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a critical sales role responsible for driving high-volume, high-velocity net new business acquisition sales in a remote selling model within the commercial segment across EMEA, specifically META. Operating as full-cycle territory owners similar to an AE, ISR manages the end-to-end sales process from self-sourcing pipeline, qualifying opportunities and closing deals in partnership with SE and Partner Organisation
 What you'll do 
 Build your own pipeline: Find new business across your assigned territory (META) through high-volume outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn and social selling, using tools like Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and AI outreach
 Run the whole sales cycle remotely: Lead discovery and qualification calls using MEDDPIC, give engaging virtual presentations and live product demos, and negotiate and close new business against an ACV quota.
 Explain the value of Cloudflare's platform: Connect commercial-segment customers' business and technical problems to the right Cloudflare products, such as Application Security and Performance, Zero Trust/SASE and the Developer Platform, and show the value they'd get.
 Work closely with other teams: Partner with Solutions Engineers on technical validation, and with the Partner Organisation to co-sell and close deals faster. Work with Marketing and BDR teammates on campaigns and events that create pipeline.
 Run your territory with data: Keep your Salesforce pipeline accurate and your forecasts reliable, track your activity and conversion numbers, and use what you learn to consistently meet or exceed your targets
 Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience: 
 1 - 3 years of experience in a sales role, preferably in SaaS or tech sales, such as: 
 BDR/SDR background with strong outbound experience in a high-paced environment
 SMB or Transactional sales experience with high volume, high velocity sales motion
 Strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota 
 Strong discovery and qualification skills using frameworks like BANT, MEDDIC 
 Excellent presentation and interpersonal communication skills (verbal and written) as well as time management skill
 Experience using CRM like Salesforce, outbound/prospecting sales tools (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce Sales Engagement Outreach etc)
 Tech-savvy and technically curious - quick to learn technical products, comfortable to run live demos independently, data-driven mindset  
 Highly accountable and self-driven, customer-centric individuals
 Multilingual abilities (depending on the coverage regions)
 What Makes Cloudflare Special?
 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 
 Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. 
 Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 
 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. 
 Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! 
 Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. 
 This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

About Dialpad 
 Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage. 
 Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved. 
 Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile. 
 Being a Dialer 
 At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more. 
 We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves. 
 We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic . 
 Your role
 As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll own building prospect lists, manage the pipeline, and maintain in-depth knowledge of Dialpad products. You’ll collaborate with your Account Executives to develop prospecting strategies and vertical campaigns unique to your territory. You’ll also support the creation of net new prospecting lists for target accounts and key decision-makers. You’ll connect with prospects using all communication channels (phone, email, and social media). In addition, you’ll bring your confidence, commitment, and love of winning to hone your craft and launch yourself into a successful sales career! 
 Dialpad’s Sales Development Representative will contribute to our Sales team by acquiring new customers, uncovering market opportunities, and getting the market talking about Dialpad! In this role, you’ll combine prospecting, lead qualification, and industry research to create qualified sales opportunities for your Account Executives. Dialpad’s Sales Development Representative team nurtures relationships with prospects, becoming the initial point of contact by performing outreach through calls, emails, and social media. This team works closely with Account Executives and has the opportunity for close mentorship and professional development. 
 This position reports to our Sales Development Manager and is based in our Tempe, AZ Office. 
 What you’ll do 
 Prospect ideal target personas by making 50+ outbound calls per day, with additional touchpoints via email. 
 Consistently meet or exceed the quota of sales-qualified opportunities for Dialpad’s Account Executive team. 
 Embrace a growth mindset by prioritizing sales enablement activities. 
 Show enthusiasm to learn and implement various sales methodologies such as SPICED and BANT. 
 Learn to navigate through sales tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Sales Navigator, and Dialpad. 
 Partner closely with your manager, peers, and Account Executives to improve messages, processes, and daily activities. 
 Skills you’ll bring   
 Efficient, organized, and detail-oriented. 
 Highly motivated and committed to achieving success, both individually and within a team. 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills and confidence. 
 Demonstrated sense of curiosity, motivation, and resourcefulness. 
 1+ year of experience in a Sales Development or similar customer-facing role. 
 Why Join Dialpad 
 Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications 
 Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate 
 Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact 
 Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth 
 We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work , ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success. 
 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.  
   Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold.

 AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
 AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.

 This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 As a member of the Applied AI, Democratic Partnerships team at Anthropic you will provide technical support to the governments of key international allies and civil-sector partners to support democratic resilience. Near-term work focuses on a few priority countries and partners, and will continue to expand with capacity. This role serves Anthropic's mission and public benefit goals.
  
 In collaboration with the Policy, National Security, Product, Research, and Engineering teams, you'll help partners build, integrate, and ship Claude deployments. You will use your excellent communication skills to explain complex topics, including the potential benefits and harms of frontier AI, to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You will also play a critical role in identifying how our AI systems can best serve public interests in frontline democracies, while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards.
 Responsibilities:
 Work directly with partner technical teams to build and ship Claude deployments. Guide their setup, architecture, and integration as they build with Claude Code and the Claude API.
 Build pilots and repeatable workflows that can scale across partner agencies, and support developer and university enablement.
 Document how to deploy Claude in low-connectivity, multilingual, and security-conscious environments, for reuse across partners.
 Act as the voice of our partners in frontline democracies and a key collaborator with our Product and Research teams to ensure we deliver the capabilities they need.
 Travel internationally to partner institutions for technical enablement and building relationships. 
 Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI.
 Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models’ capabilities.
 Support partner deployments in areas such as education, cyber resiliency and global health.
 You may be a good fit if you have:
 4+ years of experience as a Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Cybersecurity Engineer, working with governments, civil-sector organizations, or the public sector
 Experience shipping software in imperfect conditions, and a practical approach to infrastructure constraints
 Designed novel and innovative solutions for technical platforms in a developing mission area
 Comfort working directly with partner technical teams, and motivation to work on deployments where the stakes are civic rather than commercial
 Strong technical aptitude to partner with engineers and strong proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred)
 Understanding of and experience with LLM fundamentals
 The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the problem at hand, finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions
 Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders, from engineers to senior government officials
 Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $240,000 — $315,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

 Rapid growth has outpaced formal tracking, leaving initiatives reliant on informal ownership and tracking. We need a program manager to establish structure, seamlessly manage diverse workstreams, and build lasting, repeatable processes. Success is defined by delivering high-quality projects on time and maintaining clear, transparent visibility into overall department status.
 What You'll Own
 Workstream visibility. Maintain one view of cross-departmental initiatives: owners, status, dependencies and risks, with Jira as the source of truth. Run regular check-ins that keep it honest, raise concerns before they become surprises, and give leadership a clear picture of what is moving and what is not.

 A department our size can't hire a specialist for every function, and shouldn't. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.  We are looking for an executive account leader who understands that winning at the Army is not about a successful six-month prototype. It is about getting into program budgets. Scale already has proven programs across the Department of War (DoW) and in Army-adjacent work.  Own the territory and the number. Carry and exceed an annual bookings target tied to your territory. You own the full lifecycle: identifying opportunity, shaping requirements, converting to a funded award, and expanding. You build and maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your target.

 Turn proof into programs. Secure executive sponsorship and programmed funding (POM, program-office, and production vehicles) so prototypes survive the valley of death and become deployed capability.
 Tactical execution. You don't just delegate. You personally draft white papers and OTA responses, lead complex proposal development, architect deal structures, and navigate the nuances of defense acquisition.
 Renewal, expansion, and growth. Own the long-term account strategy across the Army. Defend renewals, maintain executive relationships, identify the next use case, and secure follow-on funding that turns a single deployment into an enterprise standard.
 Partner with delivery. Delivery owns execution; you own the commercial relationship. You stay close to mission outcomes and customer health, and you surface risk early, working with Engagement Managers, Technical PMs, Engineers, Product, and Customer Success.
 Direct agentic solutioning. Work with your Solutions Engineer and operators to co-design agentic AI workflows. You translate a warfighter's mission problem into a specific technical requirement our engineers can build against.
 SI and prime orchestration. With Scale's Partner Managers, negotiate with Tier 1 systems integrators and primes so Scale is the agentic AI engine inside their larger programs. You are the lead negotiator on subcontracting and teaming agreements.
 Team selling. Work with Capture, who shape demand ahead of you, and with peer AEs in adjacent territories. You deconflict before engaging an account a peer owns.
 Requirements 
 Experience: 7+ years across Army operations, government acquisitions, complex enterprise IT sales, or defense business development. Time in uniform or as a government civilian in the Army counts heavily.
 Proven track record: You have closed and implemented multi-year deals and know how to get a line item into the budget.
 Domain expertise: Deep understanding of the Army's modernization priorities and where AI/ML, computer vision, and autonomy apply.
 Valley of Death navigator: Demonstrated ability to move technology from "cool demo" to "deployed capability" inside a major PEO or program office.
 Strategic network: Existing relationships across HQDA, USARPAC, PEOs and PAEs, and ASA(ALT), plus relationships at the major primes and integrators.
 Clearance: Active TS/SCI is strongly desired; active Secret at a minimum.
 Education: BS/BA required; technical degree or MBA preferred.

 Travel: Ability to travel at least 30% of the time.

About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.
 This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.
 That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.
 What you'll do
 Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers. Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.
 Drive activation yourself. Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.
 Automate your own work. Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.
 Spend your time on strategic conversations. Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.
 Spot who is ready for more. Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.
 Build programs, not one-offs. When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.
 Be the voice of your book. Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.
 Where your time goes as we automate
 The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:
 Deeper with priority accounts. Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.
 Quarterly launches. Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.
 Events. Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.
 New signups and scaled partnerships. Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.
 The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.
 You may be a good fit if you have
 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology
 Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around
 Use AI in your own work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
 Bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and can move from a messy situation to a clear plan quickly
 Have run multi-step programs or projects with several stakeholders and kept them on track
 Have got things done through people you did not manage, across teams in a larger organization
 Stay effective when your job changes, and would see automating part of your role as a win
 Can explain AI plainly to people who are skeptical, busy or new to it
 Care about the mission of nonprofits and educational institutions, and about AI being developed and deployed safely
 Strong candidates may also
 Have built something from zero, such as a company, a product, a sales motion or a new program, or been an early employee at a startup
 Have a consulting background, with experience across many sectors and problem types
 Have worked at an AI-native company or sold AI products, or moved from business development into owning accounts
 Have worked in or with nonprofits, foundations, Universities or other mission-driven organizations
 Understand how nonprofits and universities buy, including boards, funders, procurement cycles and tight budgets
 Have used usage data to prioritize a large book of accounts
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $222,800 — $290,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications.  Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 4cfa6c6e.desc:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
 Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment.  As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.
 This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product.  AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment.   Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.
 You should apply if:   
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
 You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
 You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
 You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
 You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.
 In this role, you will:   
 Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
 Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
 Drive strategy and pilot/trial success 
 Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
 Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
 Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
 Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
 Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
 Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
 Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
 Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.
 Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
 Accommodations  
 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
 Our Commitment to Authenticity 
 We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
 Fraudulent Employment Offers

 As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

회사 소개 
 쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다.
  
 쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.
  
 대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다.
  
 보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.
  
  
 팀 소개 
 쿠팡페이의 Fintech Business Development(사업개발)팀은 카드/은행 등 다양한 외부 금융사와의 업무 제휴를 통해 결제사업을 발굴하고 시도하며, 쿠팡의 고객에게 새로운 결제 경험을 제공합니다. 쿠팡을 이용하는 고객의 목소리에 항상 귀기울이고, 효율적인 서비스 운영을 위해 개선 포인트를 찾아 지속적으로 업무 프로세스를 간소화하고 개선합니다. 이러한 시도는 결제 영역에 국한되지 않으며, 고객과 쿠팡페이에 더 많은 가치를 창출해 줄 수 있는 새로운 사업과 전략적 과제들을 발굴하고 긴밀하게 유관 부서들과 협업하며 추진합니다.
 사업개발팀에 합류 하시면, 신사업 기획부터 직접적인 프로젝트 운영까지 다양한 업무를 임팩트 있는 규모로 경험하실 수 있습니다.
  
  
 직무 소개 
 Sr. Business Development Specialist 는 카드사 및 은행 등 주요 파트너사와 협력해 쿠팡과 핀테크 서비스의 성장 기회를 발굴하고, 내부 부서와 긴밀하게 소통하며 이를 실행에 옮기는 역할을 담당합니다. 특히 고객이 쿠팡 플랫폼 내에서 최대한의 혜택을 누릴 수 있도록 PLCC(제휴카드) 사업을 지속적으로 논의하고 개선해 나갑니다. 더불어 결제 서비스 고도화와 혜택 확대를 위해 신규 파트너사를 적극적으로 발굴하여, 양사 모두가 Win-Win 할 수 있는 최적의 제휴 모델을 구축합니다.
  
  
 업무 내용

 신규 제휴사 발굴/제안/협상을 통한 파트너쉽 구축 및 기존 제휴사 관계 관리
 문제 해결을 위한 내부 유관 부서와의 협업(Product, Legal, Privacy 등)
  
  
 자격 요건 
 총 7년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
 총 3년 이상의 핀테크/간편결제/카드사/이커머스 플랫폼에서 사업개발/전략기획/마케팅/제휴영업 직무를 경험을 통해 관련 업무 지식을 보유하신 분
 카드사/은행 중심의 결제 프로세스 전반에 대한 이해도를 갖추신 분
 데이터 기반 사고 및 분석 역량을 갖추신 분
 사업 전략을 문서화(PPT/Excel)하여 논리있게 전달하고 설득할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분
 다양한 이해관계자와 원활하게 협업할 수 있는 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
 신규 서비스를 런칭하고 새로운 사업적 시도의 과정에서 문제를 해결하는 반복적 개선과정을 경험하신 분
  
  
 우대 사항 
 카드결제 관련 전산개발 프로젝트를 상위 기획부터 런칭까지 경험해보신 분
 온라인 결제 프로세스에 대한 높은 이해도를 갖추신 분
 영어 의사소통에 능숙하신 분
  
 전형 절차 및   안내   사항 
 전형 절차 
 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
 참고 사항 
 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
 고용형태는   정규직으로   수습기간  12 주를   포함 합니다 . 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

 서류   반환 정책  
 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 ( recruitingops@coupangpay.com ) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다. 
 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. At Okta, we are on a journey to build partnerships into everything we do. This role represents a key leadership position for our high-growth APJ (Asia-Pacific & Japan) expansion. The identity market across ASEAN, Greater China (HK/TW), and Korea is expanding rapidly, and our partner ecosystem is the primary engine driving this scale.
 Role Overview 
We are looking for a dynamic, hands-on Partner Team Leader (Player-Coach) to lead and accelerate our partner ecosystem across the ASEAN, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Korea regions.
This is a unique, hybrid leadership role designed for an agile leader who thrives on both strategic execution and direct sales involvement:
 The Player (SG & HK): You will act as an individual contributor and primary point of contact for our most critical strategic partners, distributors, and GSIs based in Singapore and Hong Kong, directly managing key relationships, driving pipeline, and closing high-impact deals.
 The Coach (Taiwan, Korea, & ASEAN Sub-regions): You will act as a coach, mentor, and strategic guide for the local alliance managers, country teams, and regional channel partners in Taiwan, Korea, and emerging ASEAN markets to scale partner readiness, build localized GTM strategies, and drive partner-sourced revenue growth.
 The ideal candidate will combine strong partner-business development experience with a coach-like leadership mindset, seamlessly navigating diverse APJ business cultures to build a unified, high-performing ecosystem.
 Job Duties and Responsibilities 
 Joint Strategy & Multi-Regional Execution (Player & Coach)
 Act as the "Player" in Singapore and Hong Kong to personally manage, enable, and co-sell with high-priority regional partners, key distributors, and focus GSIs to drive regional revenue targets.
 Act as the "Coach" for local teams and partner managers in South Korea, Taiwan, and ASEAN sub-regions, providing structured frameworks, deal mentorship, and pipeline-acceleration coaching.
 Formulate a cohesive regional channel strategy that unites regional resellers, distributors, system integrators, and key cloud alliance partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) under a unified Okta APJ vision.
 Revenue & Pipeline Management

  Stakeholder & Relationship Management

 Navigate internal cross-functional teams within Okta—including Field Marketing, Partner Enablement, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering—to unlock resources and resolve operational bottlenecks for partners.

Scale is building AI for the world's most important decisions. From the front lines of national defense to the core of global enterprise, we provide the data engine and agentic infrastructure that powers the next generation of American and allied interests.
 The Role 
 As an Account Executive (AE) supporting the Air Force, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and mission-critical production in the Air Force domain. You will lead the charge in deploying agentic AI, meaning autonomous, reasoning systems, into operational workflows.
 We are looking for an executive account leader who understands that winning at the Air Force is not about a successful six-month prototype. It is about getting into program budgets. Scale already has proven programs across the Department of War (DoW) and in Air-Force-adjacent work. Your mandate is to take what works, bring it to your buying centers, and convert it into funded, multi-year Air-Force business.
 This is an individual contributor role with heavy leadership expectations. You are the CEO of your territory: one accountable owner for the customer and the commercial result.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the territory and the number. Carry and exceed an annual bookings target tied to your territory. You own the full lifecycle: identifying opportunity, shaping requirements, converting to a funded award, and expanding. You build and maintain a qualified pipeline of at least 3x your target.
 Replicate what is proven. Bring proven Scale offers to new Air Force buying centers instead of starting custom pilots. You qualify hard: we pursue work that expands or connects an existing program, or that has a clear funding path.
 Turn proof into programs. Secure executive sponsorship and programmed funding (POM, program-office, and production vehicles) so prototypes survive the valley of death and become deployed capability.
 Tactical execution. You don't just delegate. You personally draft white papers and OTA responses, lead complex proposal development, architect deal structures, and navigate the nuances of defense acquisition.
 Renewal, expansion, and growth. Own the long-term account strategy across the Air Force. Defend renewals, maintain executive relationships, identify the next use case, and secure follow-on funding that turns a single deployment into an enterprise standard.
 Partner with delivery. Delivery owns execution; you own the commercial relationship. You stay close to mission outcomes and customer health, and you surface risk early, working with Engagement Managers, Technical PMs, Engineers, Product, and Customer Success.
 Direct agentic solutioning. Work with your Solutions Engineer and operators to co-design agentic AI workflows. You translate a warfighter's mission problem into a specific technical requirement our engineers can build against.
 SI and prime orchestration. With Scale's Partner Managers, negotiate with Tier 1 systems integrators and primes so Scale is the agentic AI engine inside their larger programs. You are the lead negotiator on subcontracting and teaming agreements.
 Team selling. Work with Capture, who shape demand ahead of you, and with peer AEs in adjacent territories. You deconflict before engaging an account a peer owns.
 Requirements 
 Experience: 7+ years across Air Force operations, government acquisitions, complex enterprise IT sales, or defense business development. Time in uniform or as a government civilian in the Air Force counts heavily.
 Proven track record: You have closed and implemented multi-year deals and know how to get a line item into the budget.
 Domain expertise: Deep understanding of the Air Force's modernization priorities and where AI/ML, computer vision, and autonomy apply.
 Valley of Death navigator: Demonstrated ability to move technology from "cool demo" to "deployed capability" inside a major PEO or program office.
 Strategic network: Existing relationships across HAF, AFLCMC, PEOs, and DAF CDAO, plus relationships at the major primes and integrators.
 Clearance: Active TS/SCI is strongly desired; active Secret at a minimum.
 Education: BS/BA required; technical degree or MBA preferred.
 Geography: Washington, DC, Colorado Springs, CO, and Dayton, OH, with the ability to work on-site or with the customer three days a week.
 Travel: Ability to travel at least 30% of the time.
 Who You Are 
 Mission-driven: You believe whoever wins in AI wins the next century, and you want that to be the United States and its allies.
 Relentless: You thrive in the long game of defense procurement. Bureaucracy doesn't discourage you; you see it as a puzzle to be solved.
 Adaptive: You can operate in the high-velocity environment of a fast-growing company while keeping the polish required in front of a general officer.
 The closer-operator: You have the executive presence to brief a PEO and the stamina to spend 10 hours in a SCIF on a proposal response.
 Radically accountable: You don't wait for a marketing lead or a BD specialist to hand you a deal. You build your own funnel, navigate the "no's," and find the creative path to "yes."
 Technically credible: You aren't a software engineer, but you can explain the difference between RAG and agentic reasoning to a skeptical technical evaluator.

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
 The Account Development Representative (ADR) job is the launching point for an individual looking for a successful career in SaaS sales. In this role, you will be at the front of Samsara’s go-to-market strategy. This includes hunting for leads, mapping enterprise accounts, and building demand for Samsara’s full line of products. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop enterprise technology sales skills and to advance their careers. Successful ADRs earn accelerated commissions and head down the path for promotion into closing roles.  This is a hybrid position open to candidates residing in Phoenix Metro Area of Arizona, requiring 3 days per week onsite and 2 days remote.
 You should apply if : 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
 You are the architect of your own career : If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
 You love talking to people : In this role you will average 50 calls to prospective customers daily.
 You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center.  Ability and willingness to make 50 cold calls a day.
 At least 6 months of sales experience and/or sales prospecting ability. This can be sales related coursework, sales competitions, etc. 
 Must be currently enrolled in an accredited 4-year Bachelor's degree program or within 1 year of graduation
 An ideal candidate has :
 Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
 6 Months experience with Salesforce, LI Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo.

 #LI-Hybrid

 $54,621 — $73,400 USD

 Flexible Working

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role 
 As Distributor Business Development Manager, you will own Elastic's distribution relationships and unmanaged Elastic partner strategy with distribution partners across APJ region. 
  
 The successful candidate will connect Elastic's sales teams, partner teams, and distributors in the region. Their main goal is to drive pipeline generation with the help of distributors. They will also enable resellers and execute co-sell strategies. Additionally, they will work on growing new business and increasing expansion ARR through the partner ecosystem. 
  
 This role requires a candidate with strong partner sales acumen, regional experience and proven track record of growing business with distributors. You will work with cross-functional teams, and focus on driving execution of Elastic sales plays, deep technical alignment and enablement of distributors and will scale business through distributor led partner ecosystem. 
  
 As a business leader, you will conduct executive business reviews with both the distributor and Elastic leadership teams. You should be capable and comfortable delivering demonstrations of Elastic products. You will arrange technical workshops and certification boot camps with distributors and Elastic reseller teams. Additionally, you will create and improve sales plays. And most importantly drive business execution across distributors and distributor-led partner ecosystem. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Distribution Strategy & Business Planning: 
 Manage business plans with distribution partners. Set quarterly targets for the pipeline and for recruiting resellers. Prioritize segments for Elastic's Enterprise, Public Sector, and Commercial business. 
 Build and maintain executive-level relationships with distribution executive team, and drive business growth initiatives with Elastic Field Sales teams, Managed Partners teams, and distributors 
 Develop and execute a distribution GTM playbook aligned to Elastic's Fiscal year priorities and key performance indicators such as: partner-sourced pipeline, New & Expansion business targets and reseller coverage model. 
 Work with Global Partner Sales Operations to track distributor performance using KPIs. These KPIs include partner-sourced ARR, deal registration volume, pipeline coverage ratio, and reseller activation rates. 
 Distributor and Partner Ecosystem Enablement and Development: 
 Onsite & Virtual - Independently design and deliver technical enablement programs for reseller sales engineers, architects, and pre-sales teams — onsite at distributor offices, reseller HQs, and industry events, as well as in virtual/webinar formats. 
 Build and maintain a reusable enablement content library: demo environments, hands-on lab guides, discovery decks, competitive battle-cards, and certification study aids tailored to the Elastic platform (Search, Observability, Security). 
 Run monthly/quarterly distributor enablement days with coordinated technical tracks (observability, SIEM/security analytics, vector/AI search) and business tracks (program updates, incentives, pipeline reviews). 
 Drive reseller technical certifications and training completions through proactive cohort scheduling, remediation support, and accountability reporting back to Elastic Partner Enablement. 
 Deliver or co-deliver Elastic product demonstrations for reseller-led opportunities, serving as the technical point of contact for pre-sales support through distribution when a dedicated SE is unavailable. 
 Reseller Ecosystem Development: 
 Identify, recruit, and enable net-new resellers through distribution partners; manage tiering and partner program alignment. 
 Drive reseller activation through demand generation programs, MDF utilization, and joint marketing motions with distributors 
 Maintain a healthy, active reseller pipeline across APJ markets 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: 
 Partner with Elastic Regional Sales field managers (RVPs, AEs) to integrate distribution into account and territory planning. 
 Own execution across Elastic account segments - Work with Global Partner Sales Operations & Strategy on distributor discount structures, incentive programs, and data integrity within Salesforce/Impartner. 
 Collaborate with Elastic's Marketing team to develop and deploy partner-funded demand generation campaigns through public sector distribution partners. 
 Escalate and resolve distributor-facing channel conflicts, pricing disputes, and deal registration exceptions in coordination with Global Partner Sales leadership and Deal Desk. 
 What You Bring
 7+ years of channel sales or partner management experience, with at least 3 years focused on distribution. 
 Demonstrated track record of driving partner-sourced revenue through distributor-managed reseller ecosystems. 
 Proven ability to independently deliver sales pitches and business value proposition to partners, ability to showcase product or solution demos, co-deliver hands-on workshops, and lab-based training — to Sales and technical audiences (SEs, architects, pre-sales). 
 Experience building or managing a self-sustaining partner enablement program: content design, delivery cadence, certification tracking, and outcomes measurement. 
 Hands-on fluency with at least one of the following domains: observability/monitoring, SIEM/security analytics, log management, or enterprise search — sufficient to lead credible technical conversations and live product walkthroughs. 
 Deep familiarity with account segments and how channel partners serve and execute business with Enterprise, Public Sector and commercial customers. 
 Experienced with diverse region and working directly with partners based in different countries across APJ - Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder distributor relationships across sales, marketing, and executive functions. 
 Strong command of channel mechanics: deal registration, margin stacking, MDF management, reseller tiering, and co-sell program execution. - Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, reporting, and partner attribution workflows. 
 Excellent executive communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — and equal comfort presenting to a CISO as to a room of reseller SEs. - Willingness and ability to travel onsite to distribution and reseller locations (estimated 20%–30%) for enablement events, QBRs, and partner marketing activities. 
 Bonus Points
 Direct experience with Elastic (ELK/ECE/ECK), Splunk, Datadog, CrowdStrike, or another enterprise observability or security analytics platform — including hands-on configuration or demonstration capability. 
 Familiarity with partner program platforms (Impartner, Alliances, Salesforce PRM) and co-sell tools (Tackle/Clazar, WorkSpan). - Working knowledge of cloud marketplace procurement (AWS MP, Azure MP, GCP MP) as a transactional vector through distribution. 
 Prior experience owning or supporting partner attribution framework rollouts or channel operations transformations. 
 Background in working or partnering and contributing to designing formal sales or technical training content for partner ecosystem.

This part of the journey is critical to a partner's long-term success and involves onboarding & enablement, co-selling, and supporting the building of their co-servicing practice.  Coach and Develop Partners - Empower and guide partners’ go-to-market strategy by sharing best practices for co-selling with HubSpot, packaging and pricing services, and retaining and growing customers.  2+ years of experience with technology platforms and solutions with a reasonable level of technical proficiency
 Strong sense of prioritisation and time management skills. Able to balance high volume while focusing on outcomes and results. Experience working on scale teams is a bonus.

 Excellent communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort
 Ability to proactively identify areas in the partner development strategy that require strengthening (i.e., models, process and tools). 
 Ability to identify required resources and gather requirements, drive a sense of common purpose and shared goals/vision, and deliver results as an outcome of ongoing or time-bound work
 Thrives in a fast-paced working environment, can work autonomously, and pivot quickly to changing business needs

 Hybrid work environment You can choose to work from Home, Office or Flex!
 World class new hire training and onboarding
 An education allowance up to USD$5,000 per annum

 Private health insurance allowance & Annual fitness reimbursement
 Primary Caregiver Leave of 16 weeks and Secondary Caregiver Leave for 6 weeks

 Drive Consumption & Expansion Success: Own and exceed your team’s monthly, quarterly, and annual net expansion and platform consumption targets across the installed Commercial customer base.
 Develop and Implement Account Growth Strategies: Lead the execution of strategic whitespace analysis, workload identification, and account development plans to maximize product usage and long-term customer value.
 Build Trust-Based Relationships: Foster deep, multi-threaded relationships with customer stakeholders, executive sponsors, and cross-functional teams (including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product).

 What we look for: 
 3+ years of experience leading high-growth B2B sales or account management teams within Data, AI, Cloud, or SaaS infrastructure environments.
 Deep experience with consumption-based, usage-driven, or product-led expansion sales models.
 Proven track record translating complex, technical architectures into tangible business value and operational ROI for mid-market C-suites and technical leadership.
 Strong leadership capability to coach Account Executives on account planning, workload discovery, cross-selling/upselling, and multi-threaded stakeholder management.
 High operational rigor around usage forecasting, health-metric monitoring, and pipeline management.
 Polished executive presence with outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
 Willingness to travel as needed (<25%) to co-sell and support high-impact expansion opportunities.
 Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team 
 Stripe’s Professional Services Sales team works with our most strategic users; You will help customers accelerate their growth and adoption on Stripe. This role is responsible for leading strategic conversations during pre-sales that will transform the payments and financial infrastructure for leading enterprises, ultimately driving revenue growth through our professional service offerings.
 What you’ll do 
 As an Enterprise Services Manager, you will sell Professional Services engagements to strategic clients and drive Stripe’s future growth engine by building relationships with prospective users and turning them into happy Stripe users.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the entire Professional Services sales cycle for enterprise companies.
 Partner with Account Executives on named account lists to develop account plans aimed at winning and expanding Professional Services business with enterprise clients.
 Drive the success of Professional Services by managing and forecasting bookings.
 Craft custom proposals that align with clients' business outcomes, utilizing services across Professional Services and partner offerings.
 Advise senior leadership in customer organizations on building business cases for digital transformation.
 Lead pre-sales workshops with customers, focusing on strategy, vision, discovery, and assessment.
 Shape Professional Services deals, and build and negotiate contracts/Statements of Work.
 Engage with Product and Engineering teams to influence product strategy for large clients.
 Collaborate effectively with GTM partners to integrate complementary strategies and drive mutual growth objectives.
 Prepare the delivery team with user insights to ensure that the delivery aligns with the desired business outcomes.
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 5+ years of professional services sales experience, preferably at a technology company or a consulting firm, with a track record of top performance.
 Proven experience in pre-sales and sales of sizable service engagements, as well as in contract and Statement of Work (SOW) development.
 Demonstrated ability to lead large transformational engagements using disruptive technologies.
 Thrives on the urgency and importance of working with our largest customers, achieving set objectives while balancing competing priorities.
 Ability to understand complex business requirements and develop tailored solutions.
 Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity to produce strategic insights and identify opportunities.

 Knowledge of the sales cycles associated with a SaaS product or technology platform for strategic enterprise customers.
 An in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and the ability to lead complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner.
 Experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies.

 Experience in building and scaling a go-to-market (GTM) growth discipline, including the development of strategy, processes, and operating models.
 Proven ability to create a strong growth culture within a team.
 Background in a growth-stage internet/software company and/or the payments industry.
 Familiarity with APIs and their role in digital solutions.

77683295.desc:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー (Technical Account Manager)
 Asanaのテクニカルアカウントマネジャー（Technical Account Manager: TAM）は、顧客が日々の業務において「明瞭さ（Clarity）」を見出し、Asanaを活用して成果を上げることを支援します。TAMはAsanaのエキスパートであり、顧客の成功に情熱を注ぐ生産性のプロフェッショナルです。顧客からの質問、機能リクエスト、インシデント報告に対応し、中長期的な視点でのAsana活用のためのベストプラクティスを提供します。また、Asana社内では顧客の声を製品開発に反映させるための代弁者となり、製品開発チームと対話します。TAMの成功指標は「顧客の成功」であり、顧客への深い共感（Empathy）を通じてそれを実現します。
 AsanaのTAMとして、あなたは大規模かつ複雑な要件を持つエンタープライズ顧客に対し、戦略的な技術アドバイザーとしてサポートを提供します。顧客のステークホルダーと深く連携し、技術的なイネーブルメント（定着化）を推進し、継続的な利用を確実にするとともに、Asanaの機能を顧客の長期的目標に合致させます。この役割は、強力な技術的適性、卓越した顧客への共感力、そして社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込む影響力が求められる、クロスファンクショナルなポジションです。
 【勤務地・働き方】 
 このポジションはAsana Japanの技術本部長にレポートします。
 私たちは、居住地に関わらず最適な人材をお迎えしたいと考えています。そのため、ご本人の状況に合わせて以下のいずれかの働き方を用意しています。
 関東圏にお住まいの方： 東京オフィスを拠点とした、オフィス中心のハイブリッドスケジュール（原則 月・火・木曜出社）となります。
 関東圏以外にお住まいの方（日本国内）： リモートワークでの勤務が可能です。ただし、チームビルディングや重要会議のため、 月1〜2回程度、東京オフィスへの出社をお願いしています （詳細は面接時にご案内します）。
 なお、重要な会議やオンサイト支援など、状況に応じて顧客先への訪問や国内出張が発生する場合があります。
 【主な業務内容】 
 顧客への技術的アドバイザリーとベストプラクティスの提供 
 エンタープライズ顧客の導入後における「技術的な成功（Technical Success）」に責任を持ち、Asana活用拡大の主要な技術アドバイザーおよびパートナーとして機能する。
 Asana API、サードパーティサービスとの連携、認証（SAML/SCIM）、クラウドセキュリティおよび管理者ガバナンスに関するベストプラクティスを、顧客の環境や目標に合わせて設計・提案する。
 顧客のシステムアーキテクチャ、ビジネス上の優先順位、技術構成に関する深い知識を維持し、ニーズを先読みした提案を行う。
 顧客の健全性維持とリスク管理 
 顧客との定期的なコミュニケーションや技術レビューを通じて顧客におけるAsana利活用にプロアクティブに関与し、製品価値の定着と継続的な利用を促進する。
 セールス、カスタマーサクセスマネージャ（CSM）と共同で利用パターンやエンゲージメント傾向からヘルススコアを監視し、リスクの早期発見や、利用拡大・再エンゲージメントの機会を特定する。
 各種エスカレーション、移行プロジェクト、重大インシデント対応を社内各部門と連携して主導し、予防・早期検知・透明性のあるコミュニケーションを通じてリスクを最小化する。
 社内連携と製品へのフィードバック 
 社内の技術ナレッジの標準化を推進し、再現性のあるベストプラクティスを策定・共有することで、チーム全体の提案力向上に貢献する。
 セールス、サポート、プロダクト、エンジニアリングチームと緊密に連携し、統一された顧客体験を提供する。
 顧客の声を代弁し、実際のユースケースや課題に基づいたフィードバックを行うことで、製品ロードマップへ影響を与える。
 【応募資格】 
 経験とドメイン知識 
 SaaS業界における、顧客対面型の技術的役割（TAM、ソリューションエンジニア、導入コンサルタントなど）での5年以上の経験。
 ワークフロー、自動化、ビジネスプロセス管理（BPM）など、業務プロセスに関わるSaaS・ソフトウェアを直接取り扱った経験。 
 ※インフラやセキュリティ領域専業ではなく、ビジネスロジックやアプリケーション層の課題解決に関わった経験を重視します。
 大規模なエンタープライズ顧客の複雑なステークホルダー管理を行い、プロジェクトを成功に導いた実績。
 技術的専門性 
 API、システム連携、認証プロトコル（SAML, SCIM）、および技術アーキテクチャについて、顧客と自信を持って議論できる技術的知見。
 SaaSインフラ、セキュリティ基準、エンタープライズIT環境に関する広範な理解。
 顧客の技術的な課題や質問を素早く理解し、複雑な概念を噛み砕いて解決策を提示する能力。
 コミュニケーションと言語能力 
 日本語によるネイティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力（口頭および記述）。 
 英語力は必須ではありませんが、英語の読み書きに抵抗がないこと（会社が用意するAIツールを使用しての対応でも可） 
 優れたドキュメンテーション能力、ファシリテーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力。
 技術的な内容を、現場の運用担当者から経営層（非技術者）まで、相手に合わせて分かりやすく伝える能力。
 マインドセットと姿勢 
 標準化へのリーダーシップ： 属人化を防ぎ、チーム全体の成果を最大化するために、ナレッジの共有やベストプラクティスの標準化（Playbook作成など）を率先して推進できること。
 プロセス主導型： すべての顧客に標準化された極めてポジティブな体験を提供するためのプロセスを作成、実装、改善することへの強い意欲。
 学習意欲： 新しい製品機能や技術トラブルシューティング、AIツールなどの新技術を自ら学び、業務の効率化や顧客への価値提供に活かす姿勢。
 プロアクティブな行動とコミュニケーション： 常に先回りして行動を起こし、かつ透明性の高い発信を行うことで、周囲からの信頼を確実に獲得できること。
  
 Technical Account Manager
 Our Technical Account Management (TAM) team helps customers find clarity in their work and get results with Asana . TAMs are Asana experts and productivity partners who are passionate about investing in our customers’ success . We help customers resolve technical inquiries, guide architectural decisions, and educate them on best practices for long-term scalability . Within the organization, we amplify our customers’ voices in product development and maintain an active dialogue with our product and engineering teams . 
 As a Technical Account Manager at Asana, you’ll act as a strategic technical advisor to our largest and most complex enterprise customers . You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders to drive technical enablement, ensure sustained adoption, and align Asana’s capabilities with their organizational goals . This is a cross-functional role requiring strong technical acumen, customer empathy, and the ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders . 
 This role can either be fully remote depending on where you live in Japan, or based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team . Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office . If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements . Occasional domestic travel to customer sites may be required for key meetings and on-site support. 
 What you’ll achieve 
 Own post-sales technical relationships for enterprise customers, serving as their primary advisor and partner as they scale on Asana . 
 Deliver best-practice guidance on Asana APIs, third-party integrations, authentication (SAML/SCIM), cloud security, and administrative governance tailored to each customer’s technical environment . 
 Maintain in-depth knowledge of customer technical architecture and business priorities to proactively anticipate and solve technical challenges . 
 Partner with Sales and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to monitor customer health, track engagement trends, and identify risk early while uncovering expansion opportunities . 
 Coordinate technical escalations, migration projects, and critical incidents in partnership with cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication and prompt resolution . 
 Standardize technical knowledge across the team by developing reproducible best practices, documentation, and playbooks . 
 Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to deliver a unified customer experience and advocate for customer needs on the product roadmap . 
 About you 
 Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making . 
 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing consultative technical role (such as TAM, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Consultant) within the SaaS space . 
 Background in workflow management, automation, or business process management (BPM) software, with a focus on solving problems in the application layer and business logic . 
 Proven track record partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders in large enterprise environments . 
 Strong technical acumen across APIs, system integrations, enterprise authentication protocols (SAML, SCIM), and cloud IT infrastructure . 
 Native-level fluency in Japanese (verbal and written), with professional working proficiency in written English (reading and writing, with company-provided AI translation tools welcome) . 
 Stron g presentation, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audience s . 
 Process-driven approach with a focus on establishing scalable playbooks and conti nuous operational improvement . 
 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission . If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requ irement, we still encourage you to apply . 
 About us 
 Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.
 We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 Join Asana’s Talent Network  to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.
