 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As a Sales Development Manager for Enterprise at Anthropic, you will lead the team that opens our most strategic customer relationships. You'll build and manage a team of 6-10 Business Development Representatives (BDRs) who generate high-value pipeline inside complex enterprise organizations through account-based prospecting, multi-threaded outreach, and rigorous qualification.
 Enterprise buying is long and involves many stakeholders. The work here is less about volume and more about depth: knowing an account well enough to reach the right people with the right message, and staying with it long enough to turn early conversations into real opportunities. You'll bring a strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles and organizational dynamics, and you'll coach your team to develop strategic accounts over time.
 You'll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives and with leaders across Sales, Revenue Operations, Strategy, and Marketing. You'll also develop the next generation of Anthropic's enterprise sellers, helping BDRs grow into Account Executive roles while they help the world's largest organizations adopt safe, frontier AI.
 Key responsibilities 
 Build, lead, and scale a team of BDRs focused on the Enterprise segment
 Drive strategic pipeline generation through account-based prospecting and targeted outbound campaigns to Global 2000 accounts
 Coach your team on partnering with Enterprise Account Executives to develop account plans, coordinate multi-threaded outreach, and ensure high-quality opportunity handoffs
 Establish and track KPIs focused on opportunity quality, deal size, and strategic account penetration
 Coach and model for your team on enterprise prospecting, stakeholder mapping, and complex qualification
 Build a deep understanding of enterprise buying processes, and coach the team on navigating procurement, legal, and security requirements
 Own pipeline reviews with sales leadership covering enterprise pipeline health, account penetration, and competitive positioning
 Build strong relationships with cross-functional leaders and partners across Sales, Revenue Operations, Strategy, and Marketing
 Coach and mentor BDRs on strategic prospecting, executive engagement, and career development toward Account Executive roles
 Minimum qualifications 
 Experience managing BDR, SDR, or new business Account Executive teams in an enterprise-focused sales organization
 A track record of building teams that prospect successfully into complex enterprise organizations
 Experience with account-based selling strategies, including account planning, stakeholder mapping, and multi-threaded outreach
 Hands-on proficiency with a CRM and sales engagement tooling (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar), and the analytical skills to design prospecting systems and measure pipeline quality
 Demonstrated ability to coach representatives on navigating complex organizational structures and multi-stakeholder deals
 Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to engage executive-level stakeholders
 An understanding of Anthropic’s products, ecosystem, and hands on building experience with LLMs
 Excitement about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial
 Preferred qualifications 
 Personal closing experience as an Account Executive, Account Manager, ideally in a management role
 Experience managing teams that prospect into Fortune 500 or Global 2000 accounts
 A track record of developing BDRs who move successfully into enterprise Account Executive roles
 Experience building enterprise prospecting playbooks where none existed
 Hands-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, or other AI prospecting tools, and with sales tools such as Apollo and HubSpot
 Experience in API-first, consumption-based, or platform business models
 Background in AI or machine learning, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms
 Familiarity with enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $285,000 — $350,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.  
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Partnerships at Adyen 
 Over 40% of the deals that go live at Adyen involve a partner. Our five-year plan is to push that number well north of 70%. The Scaled Partnerships team builds and activates the wider partner ecosystem behind that goal: the long tail of tech and service partners, net new partners, and the upcoming partners of tomorrow.
 The role 
 As a Scaled Partner Manager, you own and grow a portfolio of partners across your assigned markets and partner segments. You help build high-impact, long-tail partner ecosystems that generate a steady flow of referrals and pipeline.
You ensure every partner is confidently activated and supported throughout their journey, from qualification and onboarding to enablement, go-to-market, support and growth. You use repeatable approaches and data to focus your time where it matters most. You’re part of one global Scaled team, shaping the playbooks and tools used across regions. You’ll work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Partner Engineering and local commercial teams to deliver a consistent partner experience across markets.  
 What you’ll do 
 Own and grow a portfolio of partners, with France as your primary market focus, while supporting and developing other partner segments and opportunities across the wider EMEA ecosystem.
 Qualify and recruit net new partners, including inbound requests from our partner sign up or from local Commercial teams
 Run onboarding: partner agreement, portal and payouts set-up, and initial enablement
 Drive adoption of the partner program: requirements, tiering, certifications, verified integrations and benefits
 Drive partner referrals and partner-driven pipeline together with Sales and AMs
 Run repeatable activation and reactivation campaigns with Marketing
 Use dashboards and ecosystem reports to understand your portfolio, spot gaps and report on partner health
 Test new models and ideas, and turn what works into playbooks other regions can reuse 
 Who you are 
 You have 3+ years of experience in a commercial role, such as partnerships, account management or sales, owning a revenue, referral or pipeline goal
 You have managed a large partner or customer portfolio, ideally with scaled or programmatic motions
 You are a builder: you improve processes, use automation and tooling, and think in repeatable playbooks
 You are hands-on and pragmatic: you get started, keep things simple and focus on what moves the needle
 You are commercially sharp and can prioritize partners based on potential, market relevance and data
 You understand payments and the partner ecosystem (POS, ecommerce platforms, ISVs, SIs, agencies) and learn new products quickly
 You are a team player who builds trust across regions and teams, and who puts winning together before ego
 You are organized, flexible and autonomous, and thrive in a flat organization
 You have full professional proficiency (written and verbal) in English and French
 You are based in our Paris office (we are an office-first company), and are comfortable with some travel in EMEA
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments  
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.  
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Paris office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

회사 소개 
 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다. 
 쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다. 
 쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
  
  
 조직 소개 
 Coupang Ads는 세계 최고 수준의 광고 솔루션을 제공하는 조직을 지향합니다. Coupang Ads는 광고주가 매출 증대, 시장 점유율 증가, 신규 고객 확보 및 브랜드 자산 구축과 같은 마케팅 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 우리의 솔루션은 광고주의 니즈를 반영하며, 광고주의 규모와는 상관없이 그들의 비즈니스 성장을 돕기 위해 기획합니다.
 Coupang Ads는 Sales, Marketing, Video Product, Operations, Product, Engineering 팀과 같은 다기능적이고 협업적인 팀들로 구성되어 있습니다.우리는 각자의 분야에서 전문가이며 항상 광고주를 우리가 하는 모든 일의 중심에 둡니다. 우리는 제품과 서비스에 열정을 가지고 있으며 이는 우리가 하는 일의 가치를 높여 줍니다.  높은 수준의 목표에 좌절하지 않고 해낼 수 있는 방법에 대해서 고민하면서 결국 실천적인 액션으로 연결시키는 분
 잘 하고 있음에 안주하지 않고 더 잘하기 위한 방법을 찾으면서 한발 빠르게 문제/대안/실행을 실천하는 분 (능동적인 실행주의자)
 수천개 이상의 업체를 운영하는 세일즈 팀을 리딩한 경험과 존중을 기반으로 팀원들의 성장과 발전을 드라이브 해보신 분
 열심히 하는 것과 성과를 내는 것의 차이를 알고 나와 내 팀을 넘어서 조직, 회사, 광고주의 이익을 먼저 생각할 수 있는 분
 팀 및 개별 영업 사원의 Input과 Output을 데이터적으로 분석하고 이를 기반으로 목표 달성을 해 본 분
 유관부서와 협업 시 제반사항을 디테일하게 조율하면서 타임라인에 맞춰서 결과를 내는 분
  
 우대 사항 
 E-Commerce, Platform, Ad-Tech, Commerce 광고에 대한 경험 혹은 이해도를 보유한 분
 유통 전반(영업/상품/물류/판매채널 등)에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유한 분
 능숙한 MS Office Tool 활용능력(Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word 등)을 보유한 분
 각종 Business Tool 활용경험(Slack, Salesforce, Zoom, Tableau, Power BI 등)을 보유한 분
 업무상 영어 활용이 가능한 분 
  
 전형 절차 및   안내   사항 
 전형 절차 
 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 - 레퍼런스체크- 최종 합격
 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
 참고 사항 
 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.
 개인정보 처리방침  
 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.  https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/ 
 서류   반환 정책  
 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 ( recruitingops@coupang.com ) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다. 
 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

e29ed5dd.desc:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 As the Sales Manager for Life Sciences at Anthropic, you’ll lead the foundational team introducing our frontier AI platform to the pharma and biotech ecosystem, spanning large pharma, mid-size and emerging biotech, and the organizations that support drug development. You’ll build and develop a team of Strategic Account Executives who drive adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with pharmaceutical and biotech companies. You’ll bring deep domain fluency in how drugs are discovered, developed, approved, and launched to coach your team’s consultative sales approach, while becoming a trusted advisor yourself to senior pharma and biotech stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI across the drug lifecycle from target discovery through commercialization. In collaboration with Product and Marketing, you’ll continuously refine the team’s value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with decision-makers across large pharma and biotech.
 The ideal candidate has a passion for developing new market segments within pharma and biotech, pinpointing high-potential opportunities across discovery, preclinical, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing, and commercial functions, and building a team that can execute strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic’s emerging products across pharma and biotech organizations, you’ll help them accelerate the path from science to patients while advancing the ethical development of AI.
 Key responsibilities 
 Build and lead a specialized team of Strategic Account Executives covering large pharma and biotech accounts, setting growth targets by segment and coaching reps through the full sales cycle from outbound to close
 Design and oversee sales strategies tailored to the distinct procurement cycles of pharma and biotech, including R&D and discovery budgets, clinical development and operations, regulatory and CMC investment, commercial budgeting, and enterprise IT and digital transformation programs, translating market and trend analysis into account plans and campaigns that meet and exceed team revenue targets
 Identify and prioritize high-potential opportunities across target identification and drug discovery, preclinical development, clinical trial design and operations, regulatory affairs and submissions, medical affairs, manufacturing and quality (GxP), pharmacovigilance and drug safety, and commercial functions, partnering cross-functionally to differentiate Anthropic’s offering for pharma and biotech use cases
 Run a disciplined pipeline and forecasting cadence across the team, managing an evolving sales process to deliver predictable, coachable performance against quota
 Serve as Anthropic’s domain expert across the pharma and biotech value chain, including discovery research, IND-enabling studies, clinical trial operations, NDA/BLA regulatory submissions, tech transfer and manufacturing, post-market safety, and commercial launch, and translate that expertise into repeatable playbooks, frameworks, and go-to-market strategies your team and the broader field organization can scale
 Partner directly with C-suite and senior R&D leaders (CEOs, CIOs, CDOs, CSOs, CMOs, Heads of R&D, Heads of Clinical Development, Heads of Regulatory, CCOs) across pharma and biotech organizations to design multi-year AI transformation roadmaps and build long-term trusted advisor relationships
 Partner closely with Product and Applied AI to translate feedback from discovery scientists, clinical operations teams, regulatory and quality leaders, and commercial teams into product and roadmap input, strengthening Anthropic’s value proposition across the segment
 Build strategic relationships with life sciences-focused system integrators, technology vendors, CROs, CDMOs, and industry organizations to scale go-to-market capabilities
 Establish Anthropic’s position as the AI partner of choice across pharma and biotech through conference presentations, white papers, case studies, and participation in industry forums
 Codify learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices, partnering with Marketing and Enablement to scale winning use cases and proof points across pharma and biotech accounts
 Minimum qualifications 
 10+ years of experience in life sciences, with at least 5 years specifically selling into or working within pharma or biotech organizations (R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing, or commercial functions, or related consulting)
 Experience in leadership roles managing or coaching enterprise sales teams, with a track record of driving measurable revenue outcomes in pharma, biotech, or adjacent life sciences settings
 Deep understanding of business models, operations, and economics across pharma and/or biotech, including the drug development lifecycle, the regulatory environment (FDA, EMA, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11), and competitive dynamics
 A track record of managing or overseeing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles within pharma or biotech organizations, securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and scientific, regulatory, and commercial use cases
 Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing a team’s pipeline and an evolving sales process
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present confidently across pharma and biotech audiences, from discovery scientists and clinical leaders to C-suite executives
 A genuine interest in deploying AI responsibly and motivation to advance Anthropic’s mission of building safe, beneficial AI
 Preferred qualifications 
 Deep understanding of buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points across both large pharma and biotech, and across multiple functions (R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing, commercial)
 A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the pharma and biotech market, paired with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities and a willingness to roll up sleeves on deals alongside the team
 Experience developing and refining AI use cases in collaboration with customers and channel partners, spanning drug discovery, clinical development, regulatory and quality, pharmacovigilance, manufacturing, or commercial functions
 Experience building or scaling a specialized sales team from an early stage
 Passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications in drug discovery and development, with strong conviction around safe, ethical development of AI in these contexts
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $450,000 — $700,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

Talkwalker gathers data from the conversations that happen around brands - online, in the media, and within companies themselves - to uncover, understand, and actionable consumer insights. We’re seeking a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us expand Hootsuite’s and Talkwalker’s customer base. You’ll use outbound prospecting strategies to identify and target prospects, and initiate the first outreach to identify sales opportunities. Your goal is to help book meetings and fill the pipelines for the enterprise sales team. This is a hybrid role open to candidates in Vancouver and will report into the Manager, Sales Development.

 Work closely and collaboratively with Enterprise  Account Executives to develop and implement appropriate prospecting strategies
 Maintain strong relationships with the marketing team, leveraging campaigns to aid in outbound reach out
 Use technology such as Linkedin Sales Navigator and 6Sense to build pipeline
 Connect with Enterprise prospects and qualify opportunities through calls, emails, social media, and other channels
 Partner with account executives to gain access to key stakeholders in target accounts using a combination of cold outreach techniques
 Identify the needs and challenges of the prospective customer 
 Determine the prospect's interest in Hootsuite/Talkwalker’s products and services
 Schedule meetings for sales representatives with key contacts in prospective accounts
 Achieve and exceed pipeline contribution and activity goals as set out by your manager
 Perform related duties as assigned

 Some practical experience in a customer service, inbound sales or sales development position, ideally in a similar business development or sales environment
 Self-starter who desires to learn, grow, and excel in their role and enjoys being measured by targets 
 Interest in social media, social listening and digital marketing 
 Attention to detail and ability to perform administrative tasks/update CRM; ability to strategically research and develop accounts for prospecting
 Comfort with, and desire to, cold calling and outreach (email, social, video, direct mail etc)
 Comfort in front of the camera and on the phone
 Excited to thrive in a dynamic environment

 Intentional collaborator. You build positive working relationships across the business, bringing people together to foster new opportunities and to facilitate the efficient flow of information.
 Critical challenger. You have the trust in your team to ask difficult questions in order to get to the best end result.
 Active communicator. You listen actively and communicate ideas and information clearly, inclusively, and proactively.
 Integrated thinker. You look beyond your role and responsibilities to understand how your team’s work drives broader organizational goals.
 Accountable owner. You take pride in the work you’re responsible for with a mindset of ultimate accountability and reliability for the outcomes.

We are building the Finance team to help make data-driven and financially sound decisions for Scale. The Finance team is responsible for improving strategic, financial, and operational decisions by partnering with the leadership team in making critical decisions across Scale. 
The Finance team is responsible for owning the company’s budget, helping to drive quarterly and annual planning processes, allocating and deploying the company’s resources efficiently, and performing financial analyses in partnership with all departments. You will have a unique opportunity to work closely with department heads on real-time high-priority business issues and use quantitative insights to drive better decision-making across Scale. The ideal candidate will not only have the technical skills to support their recommendations but also strong interpersonal skills to manage various stakeholders. We hope you'll join us!
 You will: 
 Serve as the Finance business partner to support the Applications BU Leadership Team in quarterly and annual strategic and financial planning discussions
 Engage with the business to manage revenue, delivery, headcount and expense forecasts, own weekly and monthly financial reporting, KPIs, presentations, and other critical analysis requests
 Partner with Business Unit Owners to own and improve the Delivery and Revenue forecasting processes
 Evaluate investment strategies, facilitate ad-hoc analyses, and own special projects requiring complex financial models including, but not limited to:
 Support the launch of new product lines
 Assess new risks and opportunities for corporate initiatives (e.g. expanding operations into new locations, compensation philosophy, etc.)
 Drive internal initiatives to improve data infrastructure and reporting
 Partner closely with the accounting team during the month-end close process to ensure accurate general ledger and company-wide financial statement reporting
 Develop and maintain KPIs to assist with the decision-making that aligns with the company’s objectives 
 Ideally, you would have: 
 4+ years of financial analysis experience working directly in a Corporate Finance or a Strategic Finance role
 2 years of investment banking or top-tier consulting experience
 Management experience 
 Demonstrated excellent project management skills, ability to manage and manipulate large data sets, critically analyze existing processes, and identify opportunities for process improvement
 Strong knowledge of Google Suite, and MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); expert Excel modeling skills 
 Nice to haves: 
 A Bachelor’s degree with a major in finance or accounting
 Experience in SQL and Business Intelligence tools 
 Experience with Anaplan and/or Adaptive Insights 
 Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend. 
 The base salary range for this full-time position in the location of San Francisco is:
 $148,000 — $185,000 USD 
 PLEASE NOTE:  Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. 
 About Us:

 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.  Klaviyo's Partnerships team helps drive durable growth through our ecosystem of agency, systems integrator, and consultant partners. We work closely with partners to create demand, unlock new revenue, improve customer outcomes, and bring the full value of Klaviyo to market.
 Klaviyo is shipping faster than ever. Our product doesn't wait on multi-year plans; it evolves in weekly sprints. A business moving at this speed needs an ecosystem that keeps up, and our partners are central to how we grow. Program Partners are a vital part of that story. So we design for self-service first, then wrap it in a local community and a network of peers, so every partner still feels a human connectio n . A partner who doesn't feel valued can't make their full impact.
 At Klaviyo, we serve our partners through two experiences. Managed partners have graduated to a dedicated, high-touch Partner Account Manager by meeting our tier requirements and graduation thresholds.
 Program Partners are building their Klaviyo practice, from newly onboarded agencies and boutique specialists to established firms who work with Klaviyo on select projects and referrals. Every Program Partner gets an always-on experience of digital enablement, workshops, office hours, community, and joint go-to-market opportunities, with a clear path to a named Partner Account Manager as their Klaviyo business grows.
 Our best Partner Managers are commercial, partner-first, and highly collaborative. They know how to turn strong relationships into measurable business outcomes through joint go-to-market planning, co-sell execution, and partner enablement.  About the role
 This role primarily supports our Commercial segment, which serves small to medium brands with under $30M in company revenue. As a Partner Account Manager, Program Partners, you will own our Program Partners across the segment: the hundreds of partners who have not yet graduated to managed status.
 Program Partners are not a consolation prize. They drive new logos and Commercial coverage that other partners won't pursue, and we activate them through self-service portals, on-demand enablement, AI, and community.

You will turn that untapped potential into a reliable, repeatable source of partner-sourced revenue.
 Our motto is that no partner is left behind, and our north star is that we have no inactive partners. The Klaviyo partner program should be a valuable asset and community for every partner, helping their business, and in turn their clients, grow.

 Drive activation and commercial growth
 Increase the number of partners generating qualified opportunities and repeatable partner-sourced revenue.

 Run the book with data and AI
 Use partner health data and leading indicators (portal and content engagement, certification progress, lead registrations, pipeline, time to first deal) to decide where monthly GTM motions and sales plays should focus.
 Catch partners before they go inactive, and re-activate those who have.
 Surface accounts, opportunities, and untapped revenue or service opportunities for partners, proactively and at scale.
 Use AI and automation daily to segment the book, personalize outreach, build plays, and clear admin.

 You have 5+ years of experience in partnerships, channel, business development, sales, or a related SaaS go-to-market role.
 You have driven partner-sourced pipeline or revenue through programs and scaled motions, not only through a handful of strategic relationships.
 You have worked with agencies, consultancies or tech partners that serve small and medium brands, ideally in ecommerce or martech.
 You have a data-first mindset: you read leading indicators, build segments, and turn them into action in tools like Salesforce and Tableau.
 You are AI native: you know how to use the content, frameworks, and program resources at your disposal, and you build repeatable workflows, templates, and plays.

 You thrive in a high-pace environment, with a "1% done" mentality: you move fast, ship, learn, and iterate, with no shortcuts in an industry and product that keep innovating.

 We are “1% done” but have big plans for Klaviyo in APAC. Our Sydney team began to take shape throughout 2022 and has now built out our go to market teams in sales, customer success, services, partnerships, marketing, employee experience and product support. We opened our Singapore Hub in late 2025 and are scaling fast. As the team grows we will see a continued expansion of Klaviyo’s customer base and the building of a fantastic working culture in line with what we see elsewhere in Klaviyo but with its own local identity within our Sydney based team. This is your unique opportunity to join us at an early stage and help to shape our future Klaviyo in APAC.
